results.title: Ankita Lokhande wishes birthday to her strength safe place amp biggest blessing
results.description: Mumbai Aug 1 Popular television actress Ankita LokhandeÂ penned a lovely birthday wish for her mother on Saturday calling her her strength her safe place and her biggest blessing Ankita took to her official Instagram handle and dropped a couple of lovely photos with her mom She also went on to thank her mother for teaching her values such as kindness resilience and unconditional loveAnkitas heartfelt post for her mother went like this Happy Birthday to my Mumma There are no words big enough to describe the kind of woman my Maa is She is our strength our safe place our biggest blessing Every prayer she whisper every sacrifice she makes every hug she givesâ has built this family with nothing but love Aai tujhyasarkhi aai saglyanna milat nahi Thank you for teaching me kindness resilience and how to love unconditionally Tuzha aashirwad haach aamcha sarvat motha dhan aahe Love you beyond words Today and every day we celebrate YOU sicEarlier today the Pavitra Rishta actress uploaded a picture of herself with her mother on her Instagram Stories along with the words âMeri maa I love u and i cant repay u in any form what you gave me Happy birthday my life sicâAnkita also penned a warm birthday wish for her husband Viccky Jain on SaturdayTaking to the Stories section of her Instagram she dropped a still with VicckyWishing him a long life she penned âWish u a long long long life my world Happy birthday to the man of my lifeâFor the unversed Ankita and Viccky tied the knot in a grand ceremony back in 2021These two were recently seen gracing the cooking reality show Laughter Chefs â Unlimited EntertainmentAdditionally producer and entrepreneur Viccky launched his production house VJ Frames on his birthdayThe primary project of the banner will be an action franchise directed by filmmaker Remo DSouza featuring Tiger Shroff Abhishek Banerjee and Elvish Yadav IANS

results.title: Vicky Jain launches production house VJ Frames, announces action film with Tiger Shroff, Elvish Yadav and Abhishek Banerjee
results.description: Vicky Jain has ventured into film production with the launch of his banner, VJ Frames, on his birthday. The production house's first project is set to be a big-budget action film directed by Remo D'Souza and starring Tiger Shroff, Abhishek Banerjee, and Elvish Yadav.
